asks: How is the engine cut into parts?
answer: The core decides and touches nothing. Drivers do things: run a virtual machine, carry the network, take a checkpoint. A call asks the core for a change. The core answers with events, which say what happened, and with effects, which ask a driver to act.

sets.means: The part of the engine that decides and touches nothing.
A part of Silo that does what an effect asks.
What the app, the command or an agent sends to ask for a change.
What the core puts out to say what happened.
What the core puts out to ask a driver to act.
The central piece of Silo. The app, the command line and every tool only talk to it.
